Windows 10 (1803+) & Windows 11 · x64 & ARM64 · ~8 MB · WebView2 installs automatically · Free

Install in three steps

  1. Download the setup file above.
  2. Run it. If Windows SmartScreen appears (we're a new publisher), click More info → Run anyway — every build is open-source with published SHA-256 checksums.
  3. Launch from the Start menu — pin it to the taskbar for one-click quotes.

Good to know

The app is a lightweight native shell around the live product, so every improvement we ship appears instantly — no updates to babysit. Your account, history and saved panels are the same everywhere. Checksums and all releases live on GitHub Releases ↗.
